title: Pool protocol v1 message: capacity (router -> coordinator)
description: Sent on any membership/capacity change: a model loaded, unloaded, or excluded, a slot count change, or a VRAM change. The coordinator recomputes class advertisement from the latest capacity of connected routers (D-B7, D-C3).

router_id.description: Router_id of the sending router (as in handshake).

models.description: Full current model list of this router (not a diff).

model_id.description: Local model id (llama.cpp model name) on this router.

tags.description: Pool classes (tags) this model serves, e.g. ["pool-text-lg"].

n_ctx.description: Context window the member runs this model with.

n_slots.description: Parallel slots configured for this model.

status.description: loaded = serving pool classes; excluded = owner excluded it from pool dispatch (D-F1).

vram_mb.description: VRAM used by this model, in MiB; null if the member cannot report it.

updated_at.description: When this snapshot was taken, RFC 3339 (e.g. 2026-10-30T07:00:00Z).
